title: OMEGA Intelligence Contract v1
description: Versioned, read-only OMEGA intelligence response contract. Canonical implementation: scoring/app/intelligence_contract.py (KnockAI/Omega). Read-only: it describes intelligence; it never fetches, scores, persists, or serves. Version policy: consumers MUST reject any payload whose contractVersion is not exactly 1 (a v2 payload is a different contract); producers that add or change fields MUST bump the version. Unknown fields are rejected everywhere (additionalProperties: false). Cross-field invariants (enforced by the Python implementation; JSON Schema cannot express them): (1) ingestedAt >= observedAt; (2) asOf >= ingestedAt (point-in-time, no post-asOf ingestion); (2b) every signals[].observedAt satisfies observedAt <= asOf — point-in-time discipline is per-signal: no signal may be observed after the response's asOf; (3) availability.state == BLOCKED_BY_RIGHTS iff provenance.authorization.outcome == DENIED; (4) riskIndex.calibrationState == CALIBRATED iff riskIndex.semantics == calibrated_forecast (UNCALIBRATED iff heuristic), and CALIBRATED is constructible only with genuine residual evidence — the canonical bridges accept a closed set of calibration descriptors ('uncalibrated_heuristic', 'residual_backed' for derived signals, requiring non-empty finite residuals for the latter) and reject unknown or malformed calibration metadata fail-closed; (5) availability.state == AVAILABLE requires signals.length >= 1 and riskIndex.value != null; (6) every hypotheses[].verified is false — impact hypotheses are never presented as verified in v1. A missing value never becomes a measured zero (absent metrics appear in gaps, not as 0-valued signals).

contractVersion.description: Contract version. Exactly 1 for this schema; consumers must fail closed on any other value.

target.description: Geographic target of the intelligence response.

h3Cell.description: H3 cell index (15-char hex, any resolution; the leading 8 encodes H3 cell mode).

label.description: Human-readable target label, e.g. a city name.

observedAt.description: ISO8601 timestamp of the underlying observation (timezone required).

ingestedAt.description: ISO8601 timestamp the observation entered OMEGA (timezone required); must not precede observedAt.

asOf.description: Point-in-time the answer is valid for; the response carries no data ingested after asOf.

state.description: AVAILABLE: data present at asOf. STALE: older than the freshness window. MISSING: no observation for the target/time. UNAVAILABLE: source unreachable. BLOCKED_BY_RIGHTS: fail-closed rights gate (authorization must be DENIED).

evidenceRefs.description: Opaque evidence references (e.g. observation-id@revision strings) backing the response.

rightsState.description: Fail-closed: sources stay REVIEW until counsel + CEO GO; only an independent rights registry may set CLEAR.

outcome.description: Whether THIS response is authorized for exposure. DENIED iff availability.state is BLOCKED_BY_RIGHTS.

classification.description: SYNTHETIC: fixture/prototype data. LIVE: real-world observations. Never left implicit.

signals.description: Derived and raw signals. Absent metrics belong in gaps, never as zero-valued signals.

derived.description: true when computed from other observations.

observedAt.description: ISO8601 timestamp of this signal's observation. Point-in-time (per-signal): must not follow the response asOf.

riskIndex.description: Composite risk index over the signals. It is a heuristic index or a calibrated forecast — never presented as a loss probability, price change, or trading recommendation.

value.description: null when no index was computed (non-AVAILABLE states, or un-scored responses).

calibrationState.description: CALIBRATED requires a genuine residual-backed calibration, not merely an importable ML library. Producers must only emit CALIBRATED with residual evidence; the canonical bridges enforce a closed calibration-descriptor set and reject unknown/malformed calibration metadata fail-closed.

semantics.description: Must agree with calibrationState: CALIBRATED iff calibrated_forecast.

hypotheses.description: Unverified downstream consequences. Never presented as verified.

verified.description: Always false in v1; verification is a future, separately-gated capability.

gaps.description: Missing-data annotations, e.g. "missing: precipitation". A missing value never becomes a measured zero.
